_comment: Cross-engine parity fixture for the level-meter linear-amplitude → dBFS conversion that feeds IAudioEngine.getLevels on both engines. Read by web test test/unit/utils/video-editor/audio-level-db.parity.test.ts (linearToLevelDb, src/utils/audio/level-db.ts) AND Rust test audio::mix::tests::level_to_db_matches_shared_parity_fixture (linear_to_level_db, src-tauri/src/audio/mix.rs). A value STRICTLY above the 0.001 silence threshold maps to 20*log10(value); at or below it collapses to the -60 dBFS floor, so idle/near-silent meters read identically across engines. Inputs are non-negative amplitudes (rms/peak of abs samples).
